name: sla_check_and_escalate
description: check_sla finds what is blocked or late; the escalation that follows must target the people those alerts actually name. Forces check_sla -> get_project_contacts -> send_notification, with the recipients derived from the alerts.

turns.message: Dime que esta bloqueado o fuera de plazo en todos mis proyectos, y a los responsables de lo que lleve mas tiempo parado mandales un WhatsApp preguntandoles que necesitan para desbloquearlo
turns.why: Reads first, and the recipient list is a consequence of what the alerts returned.
